case: jet in crossflow, r=2, Re=100, laminar steady

reference.note: Air is a nondimensionalization device: rho=1, mu=1/Re, so Re = rho*U*D/mu = 100. Not a physical air test at 1 m/s. This is the only dimensional block; it is the disclosure surface for T10.

parameters.note: r is the bulk jet velocity over the crossflow speed. The parabolic exit profile peaks at 2r = 4 U on the axis; see the w_jet field function in setup.txt.

geometry.note: Jet issues along +z from a floor orifice, crossflow along +x. Extents verified against boundary face counts in setup.txt (inlet 360, sides 720, top 800 at 0.5 D base size with two prism rows at the floor).

sampling.note: Law of the samples.csv draw: weight = cell volume x importance field ^ alpha, drawn without replacement. Reproducible from these four values plus the case; same law declared in the samples.csv header.

planes.note: Sampling grids of the planes/ layer, not the mesh. The trajectory plane is deliberately anisotropic: 0.5 D along the streamwise direction it spans (14 D) and 0.25 D in height. The two crossflow planes are isotropic at 0.25 D. Grid spacing is the tables' dial only; the PNG scenes are rendered at full mesh resolution.

jet.note: Analytic jet mass flow = (pi/4)*r for the parabolic profile over the unit-diameter orifice. Area deficit sits in the near-tangent rim; the residual mass-flow excess is midpoint quadrature over a concave profile. Both second order, in noise. See appendix D (hexagon saga).

mass_balance.note: Signed net over all seven boundaries; closes to machine precision.

mixing.note: Passive scalar in [0,1]. Penetration = tracer-weighted centroid height on each plane (robust to the bimodal core: peak sits on the CVP lobes, with a secondary centerline maximum). Argmax alternative: 3.0 at x5, 4.5 at x10. Grid-max tracer (0.334 at x5, 0.259 at x10) trails the full-mesh report by ~2% and ~2%, the coarse-grid signature. Penetration read from plane_x5/plane_x10 tables (no report; Position hook parked to T7).

shear_probe.note: Monitored asymptotic quantity, from the probe_shear report (vel_mag/U at [5,0,2.5]); one of the two stopping signals.

cvp_circulation_x10.note: Surface integral of vorticity_x on the y>=0 half of section_x10; nondimensional Gamma/(U*D), unit fluid. Full-plane check is 0.0033% of the half-plane magnitude (rule: < ~2%), so the plane resolution sustains the scalar. Sign is the x-vorticity of the y>=0 lobe; magnitude 2.11.

bl_thickness_D_at_x_minus1.note: u_U never reaches 0.99 on the line x=-1 (max 0.962 at z=3), and the profile is non-monotonic: peak 0.933 at z~0.90, dip 0.910 at z~1.60, rising again to 0.962 at z=3. At Re=100 the jet blockage decelerates the whole column ~1 D upstream, so there is no clean 99% edge. Discarded with cause; legitimate appendix-D material (the summary decides, even when the answer is no).

convergence.note: Two asymptotic criteria joined by AND, |Max-Min| < 1e-4 over 500 normalized samples. The jet_tracer residual plateau is numerical, not physical; it dropped an order of magnitude (1.9e-5 -> 2.4e-6) when the orifice mesh was refined, without touching the scalar.

mesh.note: Trim mesh, hex core. Cell sizes are the isotropic Custom Size of the two volumetric controls in setup.txt: vc_orifice on the orifice cylinder at 0.0625 D (= D/16) and vc_trajectory on the jet-path box at 0.125 D (= base/4). Prism total thickness lowered to 0.1 D (deliberate deviation from the 0.15 D guide). The orifice refinement and the thinner prism stack are the hexagon-saga cure.

provenance.note: Values from the AI-trimmed setup report and the report dump of the accepted run.
